issues.description: Typo: 'stlib' should be 'stdlib' in the deprecation docstring directive
issues.detail: The new `.. deprecated:: 4.3` block in the docstring reads 'Use the stlib's :func:`contextlib.redirect_stdout`...'. This is the user-facing breadcrumb pointing migrators to the replacement, and it will render in the published docs. Fix to 'stdlib'. One-line change.

issues.description: Test does not exercise the stderr branch of the deprecated contract
issues.detail: `test_deprecated_redirected` only verifies the stdout path. The `redirected()` function takes both stdout and stderr; the deprecation must not silently change behavior for either stream before 5.0. Add an assertion exercising the stderr path (and ideally the simultaneous-both case) to lock in the full contract for the remainder of the deprecation window.

issues.description: Deprecation message and docstring omit migration guidance for the dual-stream case
issues.detail: `falcon.testing.redirected` accepts both stdout and stderr in a single call, while `contextlib.redirect_stdout` and `redirect_stderr` each cover only one stream. A caller who used `redirected(stdout=a, stderr=b)` cannot substitute a single contextlib call and must nest two (or use `ExitStack`). The deprecation warning text and the `.. deprecated::` directive should document this substitution pattern so the advertised migration is actually substitutable.

issues.description: Test does not assert the restoration/semantic invariant explicitly
issues.detail: The new test verifies the warning fires and that captured output matches, but does not document or explicitly assert that `sys.stdout` is restored after the context exits (the core invariant of the context manager) nor that the deprecated path remains semantically equivalent through 5.0. A brief comment or additional assertion stating 'deprecated path remains semantically equivalent until 5.0' would make the contract explicit rather than incidental.

synthesis.summary: The panel reaches strong consensus: this is a small, well-scoped deprecation PR that correctly retires `falcon.testing.redirected` in favor of `contextlib.redirect_stdout`/`redirect_stderr`. The deprecation decorator, docstring directive, news fragment, internal call-site migrations, and a deprecation test are all in place, and the runtime contract (try/finally restoration of `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr`) is preserved through the 4.3-to-5.0 window. No correctness defects were found. The only issues are P2 polish: a 'stlib' typo in user-facing docs (flagged unanimously), missing test coverage of the stderr branch, missing migration guidance for the dual-stream case (since contextlib lacks a 1:1 equivalent), and a test that conflates 'warning fires' with 'semantics preserved' without making the invariant explicit. Land after the typo fix; the rest are polish.
